description: NaIn(MoO₄)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.72 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.60 Å. There are four inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent InO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 19-51°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.75-1.82 Å. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three InO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 32-48°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.73-1.84 Å. In the third Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent InO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 34-58°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.74-1.84 Å. In the fourth Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three InO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-49°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.73-1.84 Å. There are two inequivalent In sites. In the first In site, In is bonded to six O atoms to form InO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MoO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of In-O bond distances ranging from 2.15-2.22 Å. In the second In site, In is bonded to six O atoms to form InO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MoO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of In-O bond distances ranging from 2.16-2.20 Å. There are sixteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Mo and one In atom.
